newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladeshis battle with police, one killed.
newsitem.headline: Bangladeshis battle with police, one killed.

text.p: Bangladeshi police shot and killed a villager on Sunday when local people, angered by the arrest of an innocent man, attacked a police station at Ramu, nine miles (15 km) from this sea resort, officials said.
They said Jabol Hussain, 38, was shot by police when hundreds of villagers stormed the station to free the man arrested by mistake while police searched for a fugitive.
Police said officers fired in self-defence.
The officials said the villagers also blocked the highway linking Cox's Bazar with the port city of Chittagong, disrupting traffic for several hours.
